appraisal_events.evidence: Sûre de le voir venir après quelques jours, aussi tendre et soumis qu'avant, lui demander une réconciliation, [Odette] prenait l'habitude de ne plus craindre de lui déplaire et même de l'irriter et lui refusait, quand cela lui était commode, les faveurs auxquelles il tenait le plus.
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator lays out a recurring mechanism in which Swann's returning tenderness and remorse make him submissive and predictable, and Odette, secure in this pattern, no longer fears displeasing him and withholds what he wants most; this exposes his weakened, dependent position and her practical leverage over him.

status_effects.explanation: Swann's cycle of jealousy giving way to remorseful tenderness leaves him predictably submissive, dependent on Odette's presence and letters, and reduced to running after her and demanding to see her daily.
Odette gains practical leverage: confident of Swann's eventual return, she stops fearing his displeasure and freely refuses him the favors he most wants.
